propositions: A declared-none file impact should keep a certified plan as valid after unrelated HEAD commits, while non-code freshness checks remain active

Empty dependency maps with explicit file_impact_scope=none must classify as none and skip whole-HEAD drift re-hashing, unlike legacy undeclared empty-impact tickets which classify as unscoped and retain whole-HEAD behavior
The authenticated manifest must emit exactly one file-scope: none line only for none-classified records; paths and unscoped manifests must remain byte-identical to pre-feature serialization

Material fingerprint must add a canonical JSON basis member for none scope including no_file_impact_reason, making reason-only edits stale while preserving legacy byte-compatibility for paths and unscoped
A none-scoped attestation recovered via resign_plan_review must preserve its authenticated none scope, and legacy manifests without file-scope declaration must be treated as unscoped
